## Summary

Describe the problem and its impact.

## Reproduction

1. List the smallest reliable sequence of steps.
2. Include the selected UI language and relevant project state.
3. Remove credentials, tokens, private paths, and other sensitive data.

## Expected behavior

Describe what you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

Describe what happened instead. Attach redacted screenshots or logs when useful.
